name: Fonts, Typography & Nerd Font Glyphs
shortDesc: Monospace coding fonts, universal glyph sets, and icon symbol patches.
detailedDesc: Essential for status bars, terminal prompts (Starship/Powerlevel10k), and coding editors.

phase.title: Desktop QoL & Ricing Utilities
phase.description: The fine-grained ricing details: clipboard managers, color pickers, screenshot annotation, polkit, portals, and fonts.

packages.name: JetBrains Mono Nerd Font (Recommended)
packages.description: The gold standard coding font, patched with thousands of Nerd Font developer icons, folder glyphs, and status symbols.
pros: Includes complete Nerd Font symbol set

packages.name: Google Noto Fonts + CJK + Emoji (Recommended)
packages.description: Google's universal typographic system. Includes standard typefaces, full Asian character coverage (CJK), and color emoji support.
cons: Multi-gigabyte disk footprint for complete international bundle

packages.name: Font Awesome Glyphs
packages.description: Web and desktop icon typeface used by many Waybar and eww status bar configs.
pros: Extensive battery, Wi-Fi, and volume symbol glyphs

packages.name: Fira Code
packages.description: Monospaced font with programming ligatures for operators like =>, <=, !=.
cons: Requires separate nerd font patch for icons
